description:
Meet your ultimate adventure companion—the all-terrain electric fat tire bike built for riders who crave speed, power, and freedom. Whether you’re cruising through the city, tackling mountain trails, or exploring sandy beaches and snowy paths, this e-bike delivers the performance you need with the comfort you deserve.

⚡ Unstoppable Power
With a 1500W peak brushless motor, you’ll experience effortless acceleration and top speeds of up to 34 MPH. Hills, rough trails, or long rides—this e-bike turns challenges into pure thrill.

🔋 Go the Distance
Ride further without worry. The 48V 15Ah removable battery gives you up to 60 miles per charge. Easily recharge it at home, work, or on the go—no more range anxiety holding you back.

🔦 Ride Safe, Day or Night
26"x4" fat tires grip any terrain with confidence, while dual disc brakes, a bright headlight, and a lockable battery keep you protected on every journey. The suspension fork and adjustable saddle guarantee a smooth, comfortable ride wherever you go.

🚴 Ride Your Way
Choose from 5 riding modes and a 7-speed gear system to match every mood—whether you want instant throttle power, pedal-assist efficiency, a steady cruise, or a classic bike workout. Perfect for city commutes and weekend adventures alike.

🛠 Built for Real Life
Crafted with a durable aluminum frame and equipped with a heavy-duty rear rack that supports up to 396 lbs, this e-bike is ready for groceries, gear, or weekend trips. Fenders keep you dry in all weather, while the smart LED display tracks your speed, battery, and mileage in real time.

✅ Ride with Confidence
Every bike meets the highest safety standards and comes with a 1-year warranty plus reliable customer support—because your adventures should always be worry-free.
